stories.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
stories.description: OpenAI fixed a P1 ChatGPT flaw that let malicious shared links execute code in signed-in sessions and access private conversations.

stories.title: Cloudflare Reports 18.2 Million Network-Layer DDoS Attacks in Q3, Up 38%
stories.description: Cloudflare mitigated 18.2 million network-layer DDoS attacks in Q3 2026, with short-burst attacks rising 208% and DNS amplification up 215%.

stories.title: TeamViewer Flaw Lets Remote Computers Attack Users Who Connect to Control Them
stories.description: TeamViewer 15.83 fixes CVE-2026-111585, which lets malicious hosts crash remote viewers and may enable code execution on some platforms.

stories.title: PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress

stories.title: Passkeys Are Better Than Passwords. But They Are Not Enough.
